text: In 1961, the Soviets designed a hundred-megaton bomb. Then they halved it, to be safe.
Even at fifty megatons, Tsar Bomba was the biggest explosion humans have ever made. Its mushroom cloud rose about sixty-four kilometres.
It fell under a huge parachute so the plane could get away. The crew were told their chances were about fifty-fifty. The shock wave dropped their plane a kilometre in the air. They made it home.
